Subject: LuminaPay - Order Form & SLA redlines

Ben —

Thanks for the run-through today. Attached is our procurement redline of the Order Form and the SLA section of the MSA (LuminaPay_SLA_redline_v1.pdf). High-level asks from LuminaPay:

- Uptime target: 99.99% (they're pushing for this across production endpoints)
- Service credit cap: remove monthly cap and allow credits to exceed 10% under extended outages
- P1 response: 15 minutes response time and 2-hour mitigation SLA
- Maintenance windows: require advance notice of 14 days for scheduled maintenance longer than 2 hours; avoid any maintenance during LuminaPay business hours (EST 8am-6pm)
- Data residency: confirm logs and audit trails retained for 18 months

We flagged a few redlines in the doc and added comments for any ambiguous language. Can Redwood provide a consolidated response and proposed countertext for the SLA clauses by early next week? LuminaPay procurement would like a call to resolve outstanding items — they suggested Wed 24 Nov.

Thanks,

LuminaPay

Appreciate the detailed redlines and the call earlier. We can respond with a consolidated counterproposal. Quick operational notes: our standard production SLA for customers of LuminaPay's anticipated profile is 99.95% with a service-credit cap at 10% monthly; increasing to 99.99% materially increases cost and changes placement of redundancy and multi-region routing.

Proposed plan:
1) I'll route the redlines to Legal and Sales Ops this morning (cc'd Kim).
2) Legal will propose alternate clause language that narrows credit triggers (measured in rolling 30-day windows) and defines P1 mitigation steps vs. initial acknowledgment.
3) Ops will provide a short t-sla cost impact snapshot for LuminaPay if they still insist on 99.99%.
4) Let's meet Wed 24 Nov at 10:00am EST for a live go/no-go on the remaining items — does that work for your team?

I've attached our current annotated Order Form (redline_orderform_v2.docx) for reference and will follow up with the internal thread to get Legal text for the SLA section.

Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: LuminaPay - Order Form & SLA redlines

Laura / Kim / Priyom —

Looping you in on LuminaPay's redlines (attached). Please see the key SLA asks they want to move to 99.99% and remove the monthly cap on credits. Specific items to advise on:

- Uptime target (LuminaPay -> 99.99%): can Legal push for availability expressed per-region and limited to our supported production endpoints? Ops: what incremental cost/architecture changes are needed to support this SLA?
- Service credits: LuminaPay removed the cap in their redline. Legal: we want to keep a cap (10% monthly) and include a 30-day rolling measurement window; propose fallback language for catastrophic failures (escalation path + commercial remedy that is not unlimited credits).
- P1 response/mitigation: LuminaPay asks 15m response and 2h mitigation. Suggest we split: 15m acknowledgment + 4h mitigation SLA for P1, with defined on-call handoff and escalation to Redwood Dedicated if needed.
- Maintenance windows: they want 14-day notice and no maintenance during EST 8–6. Ops: we can agree to 7-day notice for non-emergency maintenance and provide blackout exceptions for agreed major events; propose a maintenance calendar in the Order Form.
- Evidence & logs: retention 18 months — we can confirm logs/audit trail retention and can produce summary export on request; add pricing note if extended retention beyond default.

Ask: Laura — can you draft counter-language for the three SLA paragraphs (Availability, Credits, Incident Response) with the legal rationale? Kim — can you prepare a one-pager on ops impact and incremental cost for 99.99% vs 99.95% by EOD Monday. Priyom — please prep the customer success runbook for the proposed P1 flow; we'll share with LuminaPay on Wed call.

Thanks — Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: LuminaPay - Order Form & SLA redlines

Ben —

Thanks — I reviewed the redlines and attached an annotated MSA (annotated_msa_laura_v1.pdf) with suggested language. High-level legal position:

- Availability: Counter to 99.99%. Recommend we offer a two-tier approach: 99.95% (standard) and an optional 99.99% premium attachment that carries additional committed remediation (multi-region failover + reserved capacity) and pricing. If LuminaPay insists on baseline 99.99% we should require a signed APM/Reserved Capacity addendum.
- Credits: Strongly push back on removing the cap. Proposed language: credits are capped at 10% of monthly fees per billing period; for prolonged catastrophic failures parties will engage escalation and remedies including termination rights but not uncapped credits. This preserves commercial balance.
- P1 RTO/RPO/Response: Draft language separates "Initial Response" (15 minutes) from "Target Mitigation" (4 hours) and requires documented incident triage steps. Avoid absolute time-based mitigation guarantees that create unlimited liability — instead tie to customer cooperation and access to logs.
- Maintenance: Acceptable to require 14-day notice for planned maintenance >2 hours if we also get defined blackout windows in which we can schedule critical security updates with 72-hour notice.

If LuminaPay rejects the premium addendum approach, ask for a senior-level negotiation with VP Sales and our CPO. I can produce redline snippets for the Order Form and MSA by EOD Sunday and will mark sections to escalate.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: annotated_msa_laura_v1.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Hart <emma.hart@luminapay.com>

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: LuminaPay - Order Form & SLA redlines

Emma —

Thanks again for the redlines and for proposing a Wed call. We reviewed internally and have an initial counterproposal ahead of the call:

1) Availability: Redwood can offer 99.95% baseline across the listed production endpoints. 99.99% is available as a paid premium attachment (Reserved Capacity + multi-region failover). We'll send the pricing delta before the Wed call.

2) Service Credits: We cannot accept uncapped credits. Proposed: credits capped at 10% of monthly recurring fees per billing period; for prolonged outages parties will trigger executive escalation and commercial remediation up to and including termination.

3) P1 Response: We can commit to 15 minute initial response and target mitigation within 4 hours; mitigation commitment is subject to access to customer incident data and collaboration as defined in the incident runbook.

4) Maintenance: We'll agree to 14-day notice for planned maintenance >2 hours with a published maintenance calendar; Redwood reserves the right to schedule critical security updates with 72-hour notice.

Attached are the draft counter-snippets (redline_orderform_v2.docx) and Laura's annotated clauses are included for your review (annotated_msa_laura_v1.pdf).

Can we confirm Wed 24 Nov at 10:00am EST for a 45-minute call to finalize language? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and the DocuSign pre-link once we lock.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(attachments: redline_orderform_v2.docx, annotated_msa_laura_v1.pdf)
